basic_details.job_title: BMH Delhi Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC (Delhi) candidates as on the date of interview.

qualification.details: Registration with Delhi Medical Council of India is compulsory. Candidates must have valid DMC registration certificate at the time of interview. Candidates who have submitted receipt showing that they have applied for DMC registration at the time of interview should submit valid DMC registration certificate within 45 days of joining otherwise their candidature will be cancelled. If any post of reserved category is left vacant due to unavailability of eligible candidate, those posts may be filled with unreserved category if unreserved category candidate appear for the interview.

selection_process: Selection is based on a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Check the official notification details for eligibility and requirements.
Prepare all required original certificates and a set of attested copies along with a passport-size photograph.
Report for the walk-in interview on 13/10/2026 between 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM.
Go to Room No.-132, B.M. Hospital, H-4/5, Pitampura, Delhi-110034.
Attend the interview for document verification and personal interaction.
important_instructions: Candidates must bring photograph and a set of attested copies of all the certificates along with their originals for verification at the time of interview. For appearing in the interview, candidates shall not be paid any TA/DA by this office. Fresh candidates would be exhausted for appointment as Sr. Residents and second list would be used only after that. All Senior Residents appointments from second list will be for one year only. It would not be renewable after one year. Appointment shall be subject to medical fitness and verification of educational certificate. In case of non availability of SC/ST/OBC candidates, posts shall be filled for 89 days on adhoc basis as per combined merit of all categories. Competent Authority reserves the right to do any amendment, cancellation and changes at any stage during or after appointment.

content_sections.heading: BMH Delhi Senior Resident Important Dates
BMH Delhi Senior Resident Vacancy Details (Post-wise and Category-wise)
content_sections.text: The total number of vacancies available for the Senior Resident posts is 4.

content_sections.heading: BMH Delhi Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Registration with Delhi Medical Council of India is compulsory. Candidates must have valid DMC registration certificate at the time of interview. Candidates who have submitted receipt showing that they have applied for DMC registration at the time of interview should submit valid DMC registration certificate within 45 days of joining otherwise their candidature will be cancelled. If any post of reserved category is left vacant due to unavailability of eligible candidate, those posts may be filled with unreserved category if unreserved category candidate appear for the interview.

rows.qualification_required: MBBS Degree from MCI recognized university with P.G./Diploma/DNB qualification in respective speciality and the candidate must not have completed three years of Senior residency in any recognized institution including regular and adhoc period. If such candidates are not available in speciality, others without post graduate qualification but with 02 years of experience in concerned speciality may be considered. Registration of PG/Diploma/DNB in speciality with Delhi Medical Council is compulsory. However, for the Radiology Senior Resident valid MD/DNB degree is mandatory, candidates with three years experience without degree will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: BMH Delhi Senior Resident Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC (Delhi) candidates as on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: BMH Delhi Senior Resident Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BMH Delhi Senior Resident
content_sections.text: Check the official notification details for eligibility and requirements. Prepare all required original certificates and a set of attested copies along with a passport-size photograph. Report for the walk-in interview on 13/10/2026 between 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM. Go to Room No.-132, B.M. Hospital, H-4/5, Pitampura, Delhi-110034. Attend the interview for document verification and personal interaction.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Passport Size photo Date of Birth Certificate (Xth Class) DMC Registration Degree/Diploma Certificate (MBBS, PG) Attempt Certificate of PG degree/diploma Internship Certificate Mark-Sheets of all years (10th, 12th MBBS, PG) Caste Certificate (If applicable) OBC Certificate is considered of Delhi only with non creamy layer certificate of current year Aadhar Card/Voter Card/ Driving License /any valid photo I/card approved by Govt.

content_sections.heading: BMH Delhi Senior Resident Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring photograph and a set of attested copies of all the certificates along with their originals for verification at the time of interview. For appearing in the interview, candidates shall not be paid any TA/DA by this office. Fresh candidates would be exhausted for appointment as Sr. Residents and second list would be used only after that. All Senior Residents appointments from second list will be for one year only. It would not be renewable after one year. Appointment shall be subject to medical fitness and verification of educational certificate. In case of non availability of SC/ST/OBC candidates, posts shall be filled for 89 days on adhoc basis as per combined merit of all categories. Competent Authority reserves the right to do any amendment, cancellation and changes at any stage during or after appointment.

faq.question: Q1. What is BMH Delhi Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment process conducted by Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital, Delhi, to fill Senior Resident posts on an adhoc basis through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 13 October 2026 between 09:30 AM and 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BMH Delhi Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree with a P.G./Diploma/DNB qualification in the respective specialty and registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for General candidates?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for General candidates as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive Rs. 67,700/- in Level-11 (pre-revised Rs. 15,600-39,100 with G.P 6600).

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held in Room No.-132, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital, H-4/5, Pitampura, Delhi-110034.

faq.question: Q9. Is Delhi Medical Council registration compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes, registration with the Delhi Medical Council of India is compulsory at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tenure of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on an adhoc basis for 89 days or till a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier.
